title: The workflow that tripled my output
author: Worried_Number5115
selftext:
I’m currently building Forge, a financial RPG where all mechanics are built to teach personal finance without lecturing and allow players to make decisions that influence the game and visual structure of the world. 

I’m on month 4 of the build. 

I’m going for a 3D top down style and creating 3D models, rendering, & rigging was overloading my laptop. Due to load, my laptop couldn’t handle more than 2 heavy build lanes. 

In order to increase output, I found a cloud GPU/CPU platform that has its own MCP on GitHub and allows me to work on lanes in the cloud while also building on my laptop. There’s 2 top tier players that have an MCP. It’s about $0.35 and hour of compute work. A map can be rendered in about 5 minutes on the cloud now (with prebuilt assets) whereas it was taking hours before since my laptop couldn’t handle it 

By doing this, I now have the ability to create the expansive 3D world I want while still working on other aspects of my app simultaneously. 

Figured I’d share for those who struggle with laptop processing and looking for a way to improve it
